sources.retrieval_status: 2026-10-24: User supplied wxae005_suppl_supplementary_appendix.pdf; S1/S2 text extracted and PDF pages 2/3 visually inspected. Access blocker resolved; anatomical review remains pending.
sources.unit_basis: Registry length outputs use mm. Main article Results explicitly interprets mid-nose slope and ear height-top per 1 mm; S1 defines all five compact candidates as lengths, and S3 groups four as surface measurements and ear height-top as linear. S1/S3 do not print a unit column.
sources.definition_notes: Definitions below paraphrase the supplied supplement. Semantic kinds are not executable geometry operators: surface_distance requires a reviewed surface_polyline route; vertical_distance_to_plane requires a reviewed anatomical frame and a future operator. No anatomical implementation is approved.

pilot_candidates.definition: Straight 3D Euclidean distance between pronasale (nasal tip) and subnasale (nose/upper-lip junction). Same endpoint/chord construct as traditional nose protrusion in S2 row 15; distinct from FFR-specific surface nose protrusion in S1 row 11. Anatomical placement remains unreviewed.

Locally proposed straight 3D sellion-to-menton chord. S2 row 13 describes menton-sellion distance in the midsagittal plane; confirm midline placement and equivalence before claiming reproduction of that published measure.

compact_candidates.name: Mid-nose slope
compact_candidates.blocker: Define reproducible nasal midpoint/root placement and the surface route; do not substitute sellion or a shortest geodesic without review.
compact_candidates.visibility: local nasal surface; multiple views may be needed
compact_candidates.source_location: S1 row 9, PDF page 2; S3, PDF page 4
compact_candidates.definition: Nasal midpoint and mid-nose root delimit a surface length; the published name does not imply an angle or dimensionless gradient.

compact_candidates.name: Nose protrusion
compact_candidates.blocker: Approve anatomical endpoints and intermediate surface route; the pilot chord cannot substitute for this surface measure.
compact_candidates.source_location: S1 row 11, PDF page 2; S3, PDF page 4
compact_candidates.definition: FFR-specific nasal protrusion follows the surface between nasal tip and subnasale. The traditional S2 row 15 measure uses the same endpoints with a straight chord.

compact_candidates.name: Lateral zygomatic–gonion length
compact_candidates.blocker: Approve landmark placement, intermediate route, and whether left, right, or a bilateral summary is used; S1 does not specify side handling.
compact_candidates.source_location: S1 row 14, PDF page 2; S3, PDF page 4
compact_candidates.definition: Surface length linking the lateral zygomatic boundary with the jaw angle.

compact_candidates.name: Gonion–menton length
compact_candidates.blocker: Approve gonion/menton placement, intermediate route, and side handling; S1 does not specify left, right, or bilateral aggregation.
compact_candidates.source_location: S1 row 16, PDF page 2; S3, PDF page 4
compact_candidates.definition: Surface length linking the jaw angle with the midline inferior chin landmark.

compact_candidates.name: Ear height–top
compact_candidates.blocker: Approve upper-ear placement, side handling, and anatomical head orientation defining vertical/horizontal; implement a point-to-plane height operator. Do not use camera-image vertical or invent an orientation protocol.
compact_candidates.visibility: ear coverage missing from standard frontal-only face meshes
compact_candidates.source_location: S1 row 7, PDF page 2; S3, PDF page 4
compact_candidates.definition: Vertical separation of the upper ear boundary from a horizontal plane passing through menton; this is not the ear-to-menton 3D chord.

other_candidates.blocker: Full geometric definition not retrieved; distinct from Yu 2024 mid-nose slope.
Must specify local reference plane and landmark/surface patch. Not the subjective Abbott category or ARKit nose-path sum.

physical_scale_anchor.definition: Tape follows the facial surface from one tragion through subnasale to the opposite tragion; matched reconstruction must follow the same contact route. Endpoints alone do not define intermediate tape contact. Not a chord or automatically the shortest mesh geodesic.
physical_scale_anchor.required_protocol: Mark tragion/subnasale consistently; guided side views and full ear-adjacent surface coverage; light consistent tape contact, repeated mm readings, self-versus-assisted comparison. Human review and repeatability still pending.
physical_scale_anchor.alternative_anchor_status: No validated physical alternative selected. Analytic fixture ridge is only a mathematical smoke-test anchor.

project_surface_candidates.definition: Continuous shortest path on the unchanged triangular mesh between exact surface-attached zygion and gonion on the same side, using CGAL with exact predicates and double coordinate constructions. Not a validated physical tape route.
project_surface_candidates.source_relation: Candidate operationalization of Yu 2024 S1 row 14; that source describes a lateral cheekbone endpoint without explicitly naming zygion. Equivalence remains unverified.
limitations: Continuous solver accuracy is limited by supplied mesh geometry and floating-point constructions; mesh-edge comparison can overestimate length.
A shortest mesh route need not reproduce a physical tape route.
No bilateral averaging; absent endpoints and disconnected surfaces have no distance.
Legacy lateral_zygomatic_edge annotations are preserved separately and never treated as zygion automatically.
